AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.
THIS AGENDA HAS BEEN AMENDED TO INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING NOTICE:
This Planning Commission meeting of May 19, 2020 is being held pursuant to Executive Order N-25-20 issued by California Governor Gavin Newsom on March 12, 2020 to further the State's efforts to control the spread of COVID-19 Coronavirus. Any and all Planning Commissioners may attend and participate by teleconference/virtual meeting. Members of the public may also attend by teleconference in order to observe and provide public comment during the meeting. The meeting will not be livestreamed. If you wish to participate, the following process must be followed.
The meeting will begin promptly at 6:30 p.m. so please prepare and join the meeting in advance of 6:30 p.m. The Zoom Meeting ID is 891 5543 6161 (direct link: https://zoom.us/j/89155436161).

Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Planning Commission is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

ACTION MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MAY 19, 2020
Council Chambers  Tuesday
City Hall  May 19, 2020
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present:  Wade, Roos, Walker, Lazarro, Criley
Absent:  None
Also present: Acting City Manager Ken Rukavina, Planning Manager Brianna Rindge, Planner Maddie
  Bright, Assistant City Attorney John Cotti

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

  Speakers: None

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  DENIAL RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1169 FOR M-1370-20; Denial of a Miscellaneous
  Application for an accessory structure exceeding 8’ at the single-family residence located at 1608
  Chelsea Road. Lot 12, Block 1272, Tract 7140. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner: Lynn & Eric Kim

  Action: Wade moved and Criley seconded to approve Resolution No. PCR-2020-1169 (5-0 in favor)
  denying the application with the requirement to remove the structure within six months and that,
  within those six months, the structure may only be used between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m.

OLD BUSINESS

2.  M-1360-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1161); Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application
  for a nonstandard encroachment at the single-family residence located at 744 Cloyden Road. Lot
  16, Block 1276, Tract 7140. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner/Appellant: Dale Sanchez

  Speakers: None

Action Minutes  Page 1 of 3
May 19, 2020 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
   Action: Walker moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (5-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the following condition: The nonstandard driveway presented as “Option A” may
  remain exactly as shown on the approved site plan with the execution of a license agreement.

NEW BUSINESS

3.  NC-1671/G-1637/M-1380-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1176); Consideration of
  Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading and Miscellaneous Applications for a new single-family
  residence with nonstandard encroachments within the right-of-way located at 704 Via Horcada.
  Lot 1, Block 1429, Tract 8523. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Jeff Dahl, 1102 Main St, Huntington Beach, CA 92648
  Owner: Dave Farrell, 10 Hidden Valley Rd, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274

  Speakers: None

  Action: Continued.

4.  NC-1673/G-1639-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1177); Consideration of Neighborhood
  Compatibility and Grading Applications for a new single-family residence located at 2004 Muros
  Place. Lot 56, Tract 30905. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner: Colin Coleman, 5136 Kingspine Rd, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274

  Speakers: Barbara Amaral, Vivianna Rocha

  Action: Wade moved and Walker seconded to approve the application (5-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the following condition: Roof and surface flow runoff from the project site shall be
  minimized by directing runoff through to vegetated areas before discharge.

5.  APPEAL OF MINOR MODIFICATION (MOD-127-20) TO NC-1568/G-1581/M-1143-16;
  Appeal of Minor Modification Application for the new single-family residence located at 1805 Via
  Arriba. Lot 28, Block 1615, Tract 6884. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Miles Pritzkat, 306 Vista Del Mar A, Redondo Beach, CA 90277
  Owner: Jay Yamamoto
  Appellant: Mel & Nora Masuda, 1809 Via Arriba, PVE, CA 90274

  Speaker: Armen Goenjian

  Action: Walker moved and Criley seconded to deny the appeal and approve the application as
  submitted (5-0 in favor).

ITEMS OF INFORMATION

13.  Administrative Approvals – Reviewed and filed.

Action Minutes  Page 2 of 3
May 19, 2020 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
 14.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule – Reviewed and filed.

ACTION MINUTES

15.  Meeting of April 21, 2020.

  Action: Wade moved and Roos seconded to receive and file (5-0 in favor).

Adjourned at 9:53 P.M.
